506|protected noncomputable def pointwiseSetMulAction [SMulCommClass R R M] :
   507|    MulAction (Set R) (Submodule R M) where
   508|  one_smul x := show {(1 : R)} • x = x from SetLike.ext fun m =>
   509|    (mem_singleton_set_smul _ _ _).trans ⟨by rintro ⟨_, h, rfl⟩; rwa [one_smul],
   510|      fun h => ⟨m, h, (one_smul _ _).symm⟩⟩
   511|  mul_smul s t x := le_antisymm
   512|    (set_smul_le _ _ _ <| by rintro _ _ ⟨_, _, _, _, rfl⟩ _; rw [mul_smul]; aesop)
   513|    (set_smul_le _ _ _ fun r m hr hm ↦ by
   514|      have : SMulCommClass R R x := ⟨fun r s m => Subtype.ext <| smul_comm _ _ _⟩
   515|      obtain ⟨c, hc1, rfl⟩ := mem_set_smul _ _ _ |>.mp hm
   516|      rw [Finsupp.sum, AddSubmonoid.coe_finset_sum]
   517|      simp only [SetLike.val_smul, Finset.smul_sum, smul_smul]
   518|      exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun r' hr' ↦
   519|        mem_set_smul_of_mem_mem (Set.mul_mem_mul hr (hc1 hr')) (c _).2)
   520|
   521|scoped[Pointwise] attribute [instance] Submodule.pointwiseSetMulAction

   524|/-- In a ring, sets acts on submodules. -/
